title: Buddy Petit, Kid Rena and Sharkey Bonano
summary: He names Buddy Petit and Kid Rena as favourite high trumpeters and says Sharkey Bonano used to listen to Rena and plays close to him.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: No. Just ordinary loud trumpet players. You all have to get anything on the old man Petit? Not much. Not much. Not much. I don't see how you all did. I don't know anything much about him, playing around here, but that's before my time. But when I was playing, he was still living though.
Bill knew him, you know. I knew him too.

I once made a record of him when he was pretty deaf in the end. He didn't have teeth, you know. He played little though. You all get anything on Buddy Petit? Some people tell us about him, but not so many facts yet, you know. Just we don't know exactly how old he was or things of that kind. Of course, it's hard to find, trace those things. Kid Rene? Kid Rene. We talked to his brother. Joe? Mm-hmm.
Did you work with Buddy Petit much?
I played a few jobs. I don't see how I was in the band at all. The other guys couldn't play well that high, you know.
Mm-hmm. Who was your favorite trumpet player of all the ones you heard when you were young? When I was young? Real old timers.
Well, I can give you two, that's all, is that alright? Sure. Buddy Petit and Kid Rene.
You like Sharky and Sharky tell you how Rene.
Yeah, they say Sharky used to follow Rene.

That's correct. Right on this new man in Claiborne, see. He just had this sabotaging on Sunday evening and the two bands would meet there, see. And you see Sharky standing on the corner listening in, see. That's facts. I'll tell you facts.

Yeah. You remember seeing him then? I remember. Do you notice anything in Sharky's style that reminds you at all of... Rene. Kid Rene, yeah. Do you notice any of Rene in Sharky's style? Yeah, he has a lot of... Oh, he do? Yeah, he has a lot of... Do you think he comes fairly close?
Close to Rene, yeah. You do? That's right. He's the closest Dixieland man ever, Sharky is.
Did Rene play higher? Some people told us he played pretty high though. He played high, yeah. He's a high trumpet player. Sharky doesn't usually go so high.
No, Sharky don't play as high, but Rene was a high pitched man, trumpet. And Buddy Petit was a high trumpet player. He played right in the stairs for a long time.
